entities.summary: Bret Steven Taylor is an American computer programmer and entrepreneur. He led the team that co-created Google Maps, was the chief technology officer (CTO) of Facebook, chairman of Twitter, Inc.'s board of directors prior to its acquisition by Elon Musk, and co-CEO of Salesforce. Taylor was also one of the founders of FriendFeed and the creator of collaborative productivity software Quip.
